name: Tank Node
description: I am a sensor node on the irrigation water tank. I measure the water level in percent and can open the irrigation valve when told to.

sensors.name: water_level
sensors.description: Water left in the irrigation tank; the valve must not open below 10 %.

triggers.name: valve
triggers.description: Open the irrigation valve for a number of seconds to water the beds. Use it when soil moisture is low and the tank has water.
